name: Kirkland Signature Wild Smoked Sockeye Salmon Lox (2 x 12 oz)
whyItWorks: Thinly sliced, cold-smoked wild Alaskan salmon melts in the mouth with zero chewing effort. High in natural omega-3 fats with zero rough fiber, making it an excellent topping for sourdough or plain bagels.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat chilled right from the pack. Note: High in natural salt; drink plenty of water alongside.
